comment: Pinned upstream of the libcamera source package (docs/71, docs/73): Ubuntu's 0.7.0-1ubuntu2, built whole (it used to be Ubuntu's binary packages with our libcamera.so swapped in). packages/libcamera/debian replaces its debian/ (Ubuntu's packaging plus our patches under debian/patches/rungic); the virtual cameras' configuration (desktop/libcamera/virtual.yaml) is placed by the overlay and installed by libcamera0.7.install.
